title: Grant admin access to all joined players and enable unlimited TRP coin admin tools

requirements.text: Change authorization so that every player who has joined the game (i.e., has a saved user profile / has #user permission) is treated as an admin for permission checks and for `isCallerAdmin()` / `getCallerUserRole()` responses.

quotes: everyone who has joined the game give them admin

acceptanceCriteria: When an authenticated principal has created/saved a profile, `actor.isCallerAdmin()` returns `true` for that principal.
Admin-only backend entrypoints protected by `#admin` permission (e.g., system initialization) can be called successfully by any joined player.
Unauthenticated callers (no identity) are still not treated as admin and cannot access admin-only backend entrypoints.

requirements.text: Implement backend functionality to allow admins to grant an arbitrary (unlimited) amount of TRP coins to any specified user principal, updating that user's `UserProfile.balance` accordingly and returning a success result or an explicit error if the user does not exist.

quotes: give them admin which makes them add as much trp coins as they want

acceptanceCriteria: A new or existing backend method exists for granting TRP coins that accepts (target user principal, amount) and increases the target user’s balance by the given amount.
The grant method traps/returns an error if the target user profile does not exist.
There is no artificial maximum imposed on the grant amount beyond Motoko/Nat limits.

requirements.text: Enable the in-game Admin section for all joined players by adjusting the admin gating so that any authenticated user who has joined the game can access all `/admin/*` routes without seeing an access-denied screen.

quotes: do anything they want through a section in the game that says admin

acceptanceCriteria: A logged-in user with a saved profile can navigate to `/admin` and see `AdminHomePage` without being blocked by `AdminGuard`.
A logged-out user navigating to `/admin` still sees an access denied message prompting login.
Admin routes under `/admin/*` are consistently accessible to joined players (no inconsistent gating between pages).

requirements.text: Enable the Admin "Grant TRP Coins" UI so that it is usable (inputs and button enabled) and wired to the backend TRP coin grant method; on success it shows a confirmation toast, and on error it shows the backend error message.

quotes: add as much trp coins as they want

acceptanceCriteria: On `AdminEconomyToolsPage`, the principal input, amount input, and grant button are enabled for joined players.
Submitting a valid principal and amount calls the React Query mutation and triggers a backend request.
On success, a toast indicates the TRP coin grant succeeded and relevant profile queries are invalidated/refetched.
On failure, a toast displays a helpful error message (e.g., user not found).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo` (no additional backend services).
Do not edit files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or other paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Adding real-time multiplayer or WebSocket-based admin control.
Implementing currently placeholder admin pages (cars/templates/banners/trails/etc.) beyond ensuring access is granted as requested.
